messages.content: Hi I'm Michael, Dickinson area. Insurance just denied my test strips claim. Can you help me get it covered?
Hi Michael, sorry to hear that. I can't process insurance appeals, but I can connect you with a nurse who handles those. Want me to escalate?
How long does that take? I'm down to like 3 strips
Median wait is 31 hours. Not great I know, but they know insurance inside and out. Should I set it up?
Yeah do it. Also my blood sugar was 340 this morning—should I change my insulin?
I can't advise on insulin changes. That's between you and your nurse or doctor. I'll log your reading though and she'll see it all when I escalate.
Logged 340 and escalating now. Nurse will call within 31 hours about your strips and the high reading both.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
